title: Perhaps Even He Does Not Know
devanagari: यदि वा दधे यदि वा न।
न्सो अङ्ग वेद यदि वा न वेद॥
translation: From where this creation arose, whether it was made or not, he who watches over it in the highest heaven, he surely knows. Or perhaps he does not know.
translation_hi: यह सृष्टि जहाँ से उत्पन्न हुई, चाहे किसी ने इसे बनाया हो या न बनाया हो, जो परम आकाश में इसका अध्यक्ष है, वह निश्चय ही जानता है। या शायद वह भी नहीं जानता।
science: The hymn ends with honest uncertainty. That humility, admitting what we do not know, is also the starting point of science.
